services.name: Honolulu Surf Film Festival
services.desc: In the 1980s, Anna Trent Moore, daughter of big wave surfing legend Buzzy Trent, made a series of tape recordings of her father. “He had a bigger-than-life personality and lived during the birth of big wave surfing,” she said via Zoom from her home in California. “But he was very private. After my mother passed away, he became very introspective.” That is when Anna began carrying a small tape recorder with her. For about a month she switched it on whenever her father started reminiscing. Years later her husband, Ron Moore, began listening to the tapes-now dubbed the Buzzy Trent Tapes-and found the stories fascinating. The result was their 2010 book Increments of Fear: The Buzzy Trent Story.
